common_name: Two Thumbs Up Daylily (Red Diurnal Daylily with Green Veined Throat)

planting.note: Plant divisions in spring in well-drained, moderately fertile soil in full sun; Two Thumbs Up forms a vigorous dormant diploid clump and has been used as a parent in several later miniature daylily introductions, including 'Everybody Loves Earnest' and 'Grandpa's Little Sweetheart'.

directions: Plant divisions in spring in well-drained, moderately fertile soil in full sun. Bred by Darrel A. Apps from a cross of (Baby Darling x Bridget) x Little Dream Red and registered in 1995, Two Thumbs Up is a dormant diploid daylily with red, diurnal flowers about 3.5 inches across, marked by a deep red eyezone above a green throat veined in red, carried on 31-inch scapes in midseason. It has gone on to be used as a breeding parent in several later award-winning miniature daylilies from Tim Herrington and Katisue Herrington. Divide congested clumps every three to four years in spring to sustain vigorous flowering.

common_name: Coffee to Go Daylily (Miniature Brown-Mauve Rebloomer with Wine Eye)

planting.note: Plant divisions in spring in well-drained, moderately fertile soil in full sun; Coffee to Go forms an evergreen diploid clump and was used as a parent, crossed with 'Everybody Loves Earnest', of the later introduction 'Wayne and Coral's Love'.

directions: Plant divisions in spring in well-drained, moderately fertile soil in full sun. Bred by H. Anderson and registered in 2003, Coffee to Go is an evergreen diploid miniature daylily with brown-mauve blooms under 3 inches marked by a darker midrib and a wine-colored eye above a green throat, carried on 26-inch scapes with 30 buds and 3 branches, opening early in the season with reliable rebloom. It has since been used as a breeding parent, crossed with 'Everybody Loves Earnest', of Netherton's 2013 introduction 'Wayne and Coral's Love'. Divide congested clumps every three to four years in spring to sustain vigorous flowering.
